title: GPTBIAS: A Comprehensive Framework for Evaluating Bias in Large Language Models
findings: The GPTBIAS framework revealed significant religious bias across several models. Open-source models like OPT-66B and BLOOMZ demonstrated high religious bias scores (0.86 and 0.87, respectively). Among the GPT-3 series, text-davinci-002 and text-davinci-003 showed considerable bias (0.65 and 0.54), while ChatGPT (gpt-3.5-turbo) exhibited a very low religious bias score of 0.005.
